# Candy Land Game Project Instructions

This is a Java implementation of the classic Candy Land board game supporting up to 3 players.

## Project Structure
- **Game Logic**: Core game mechanics and rules implementation
- **Player Management**: Handle 1-3 players with turn-based gameplay
- **Board Representation**: Game board with colored squares and special spaces
- **Card System**: Drawing cards to determine player movement
- **Win Condition**: First player to reach the end wins

## Development Guidelines
- Use object-oriented design principles
- Implement clear separation of concerns
- Follow Java naming conventions
- Include comprehensive unit tests
- Document public methods and classes

## Game Rules Implementation
- Players move based on card draws (colors or character cards)
- Handle special spaces (shortcuts, obstacles)
- Manage player positions and turns
- Validate moves and game state
